name: Okazaki Nanana
source:
Misato's colleague, a school nurse who was recently transferred here. She has a bright and approachable personality, but also has a somewhat careless side.

Though she looks a bit young, she's a born nymphomaniac and apparently had affairs with students at her previous school.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=698875&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
